stem:
Kabir tests two liquids with blue litmus and red litmus.
Liquid P: blue litmus turns red; red litmus stays red.
Liquid Q: blue litmus stays blue; red litmus turns blue.

Which claims are correct? One or more options may be correct.

options.text: Liquid P is neutral because red litmus did not change colour.
Liquid Q is acidic because one of the papers changed colour.

teacher.key_rationale: Blue to red with red unchanged means acidic. Blue unchanged with red to blue means basic. Unchanged red alone does not make P neutral. A single colour change does not make Q acidic.
